build_masked_lm_model: build a MaskedLMModel instance using build_model with args and a fairseq task
build_bert_base_architecture: build a BERT base masked language model with 12 layers and 768 embedding dimensions
build_bert_large_architecture: build a BERT large masked language model with 24 layers and 1024 embedding dimensions
build_xlm_architecture: build an XLM base masked language model with 6 layers and single segment support
run_masked_lm_encoder_forward: run the MaskedLMEncoder forward pass with src_tokens and optional segment_labels to get logits
